note: Phase 1 of Auster: household questions with one checkable answer each. kind says how quiz.py grades the reply. tail adds 'End your reply with a final line of the form: Answer: <answer>'. The house note in group 'reading' is invented.
house_note: House note. Bins: the green bin goes out on Tuesdays; the black bin every other Thursday, next on 12 June. Piano lesson on Wednesdays at 16:00 with Ms Ortiz. The dog's flea treatment is due on the 3rd of each month. The spare key is with the neighbour at number 14. The Wi-Fi password is on the fridge.

questions.q: A recipe for 4 people needs 300 g of rice. How many grams for 10 people?
Our home insurance costs 1260 a year. How much is that per month?
A bill of 96 is split between 3 adults and 2 children. Each child pays half of what each adult pays. How much does each adult pay?
What is 15% of 240?
A bottle holds 1.5 litres and a glass holds 250 ml. How many full glasses can be poured?
Three children share 20 sweets equally and the rest go back in the jar. How many go back in the jar?
A car uses 6 litres of fuel per 100 km. How many litres does it need for 250 km?
We buy 3 boxes of 12 eggs and use 2 eggs a day. For how many full days do the eggs last?
A sofa costs 840 and is reduced by 25%. What is the new price?
Electricity costs 0.32 per kWh. A 2 kW heater runs for 3 hours a day. What does it cost per day?
Four friends paid 18, 22, 15 and 25 towards a shared meal. To split the total equally, how much should each have paid?
A recipe needs 3/4 of a cup of sugar. How many cups are needed for three batches?
A room is 4.5 m by 3.2 m. What is its floor area in square metres?
Our water bill was 63 for 21 days. At the same rate, what would 30 days cost?
A child saves 7 a week. How many weeks does it take to save at least 100?
One litre of paint covers 12 square metres. The walls are 54 square metres in all and need two coats. How many litres are needed?

Dinner must be on the table at 18:30. The chicken needs 1 hour 45 minutes in the oven, including a 15 minute rest after it comes out. At what time must it go in? Give the time as HH:MM in 24-hour form.
A train leaves at 08:47 and arrives at 11:12 the same day. How many minutes is the journey?
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week is it 10 days from now?
A school term starts on Monday 2 March and lasts 6 weeks. On what date does the last Friday of the term fall? Give the answer as day and month, for example 9 April.
A 40-minute wash starts at 21:35. At what time does it finish? Give the time as HH:MM in 24-hour form.
Counting 1 January but not 25 December, how many days are there from 25 December to 1 January of the next year?
In a year that is not a leap year, 1 March is a Sunday. What day of the week is 1 April?
A medicine is taken every 6 hours, with the first dose at 07:00. At what time is the fourth dose? Give the time as HH:MM in 24-hour form.
How many minutes are there in 3.5 hours?
School pickup is at 15:10 and the drive takes 25 minutes. At what time must we leave? Give the time as HH:MM in 24-hour form.
Someone was born on 29 February 2012. By 1 March 2025, how many times had 29 February come round again after the day they were born?
Convert 350 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius, rounded to the nearest whole number.
How many millilitres are there in 2.5 litres?
Convert 5 miles to kilometres, to one decimal place.
A baby weighs 3.6 kg. How much is that in grams?
Convert 180 degrees Celsius to Fahrenheit.
How many seconds are there in one day?
If one cup is 16 tablespoons, how many tablespoons are in a quarter of a cup?
Reply with only the word yes, in lower case.
Name exactly three vegetables, separated by commas, and nothing else.
Reply in capital letters only: what colour is the sky on a clear day?
Give a JSON object with the keys "item" and "quantity" for: two litres of milk. Reply with the JSON only.
In no more than five words: what is the capital of France?
Name the two days of the weekend, separated by a semicolon, and nothing else.
Write the number twelve as digits only.
Reply with the word done and nothing else.
